public_rationale: The foundational scaling paper describes empirical relationships and explicitly acknowledges that it lacks a solid theoretical understanding of them. It also discusses extrapolation limits. Calling these relationships laws therefore does not make their indefinite continuation guaranteed. Marcus's statement accurately describes their evidential status.
limitations: An empirical relationship can remain useful and predictive without being guaranteed.
The finding does not establish when any particular scaling relationship will fail.

The target is the scientific status of the accumulated scaling research available before publication. The surrounding reference to months or years supplies no definite lower bound.
